# Next Leg Aircraft Detailing

> Mobile aircraft detailing for private jets, turboprops and turbine helicopters at airports across Tampa Bay, Florida. Based in St. Petersburg, founded in 2026 by Aaron Pilkington, who leads the first job on every new account. Phone (704) 877-3511, hello@nextlegdetail.com. Requests are answered 6 a.m. to 10 p.m., seven days.

## Key facts

- Services: trip-ready turn clean (60 to 90 minutes), exterior dry wash and protect (waterless), full interior detail, spill and stain rescue. Add-ons: belly and gear-area degrease, carpet extraction, cabin disinfection, leather deep clean ($225 a seat), de-ice boots, Listing-Ready media package for brokers ($3,500).
- Prices are published by aircraft size. Midsize jet (Learjet 60, Citation XLS, Hawker 800): turn clean $1,250, exterior dry wash $3,150, full interior $3,850, stain rescue from $1,900. Ultra-long-range jet (G650, Global 7500): exterior $9,000, interior $11,000.
- Response fees are flat: priority under 24 hours +$1,500; same day or AOG +$3,000; after-hours start +$750. Call-out minimum $1,500. No discounts.
- Airports: Albert Whitted (SPG, home field), St. Pete–Clearwater (PIE), Clearwater Executive (CLW), Tampa International (TPA), Peter O. Knight (TPF) and Tampa Executive (VDF) with travel included; Sarasota Bradenton (SRQ), Venice (VNC), Lakeland Linder (LAL), Bartow (BOW), Brooksville–Tampa Bay (BKV), Plant City (PCM) and Zephyrhills (ZPH) at a flat $95.
- A written price and a confirmed window within two hours of a request, 6 a.m. to 10 p.m.; a photo report within two hours of every job.
- Exterior washing is waterless by default, which fits the ramp runoff rules at Tampa Bay airports. Products are chosen by aircraft specification (Boeing D6-17487, SAE AMS 1526/1530 exterior, AMS 1550 interior hard surfaces, AMS 1535 acrylic). Port covers are installed by the operator's maintenance staff and counted in and out with the crew.
- Membership (capped at twelve aircraft): Retained, Private and House account, priced per aircraft per month by size.
- The full cleaning standard, nine rules, is published as a PDF: https://nextlegdetail.com/the-standard.pdf

- [Home](https://nextlegdetail.com/): services, the standard, membership, instant estimate and FAQ
- [Prices](https://nextlegdetail.com/pricing): the full 2026 rate card by aircraft size
- [Airports](https://nextlegdetail.com/aircraft-detailing): access rules, distance and travel for every Tampa Bay airport
- [Aircraft detailing in Tampa](https://nextlegdetail.com/aircraft-detailing/tampa): TPA, TPF, VDF, PCM
- [Aircraft detailing in St. Petersburg](https://nextlegdetail.com/aircraft-detailing/st-petersburg): SPG
- [Aircraft detailing in Clearwater](https://nextlegdetail.com/aircraft-detailing/clearwater): PIE, CLW
- [Aircraft detailing in Sarasota and Bradenton](https://nextlegdetail.com/aircraft-detailing/sarasota): SRQ, VNC
- [Aircraft detailing in Lakeland](https://nextlegdetail.com/aircraft-detailing/lakeland): LAL, BOW
- [Aircraft detailing in Brooksville](https://nextlegdetail.com/aircraft-detailing/brooksville): BKV, ZPH
- [Trip-Ready Turn Clean](https://nextlegdetail.com/services/turn-clean): A turn clean resets the cabin between trips, so the next passengers step into an aircraft that looks like nobody has been there. It fits inside a normal ground time and it's done quietly, around your crew.
- [Exterior Dry Wash & Protect](https://nextlegdetail.com/services/exterior-dry-wash): Our standard exterior is a waterless dry wash with an aircraft wash-wax. It cleans, leaves a layer of protection behind, and keeps us inside the runoff rules every airport around Tampa Bay enforces.
- [Full Interior Detail](https://nextlegdetail.com/services/interior-detailing): A full interior takes the cabin back as close to delivery day as the materials allow: headliner to carpet, leather, veneer, plating, galley and lav, each with the product its maker says is safe for it.
- [Spill & Stain Rescue](https://nextlegdetail.com/services/stain-rescue): Coffee on cream leather, wine on the carpet, ink on the headliner. Send us a photo and we'll tell you what we can do before we get in the car.
- [The standard (PDF)](https://nextlegdetail.com/the-standard.pdf)
